definitions: The action of mentioning or alluding to something.
A source of information, especially of an academic nature.
A letter from a previous employer testifying to someone's ability or reliability, typically used when applying for a new job.
A person who can provide information about another person's character or abilities.
A mark or symbol referring a reader to a note or explanation elsewhere in the text.
examples: He made a reference to the recent events.
This book is an excellent reference.
She asked her former manager for a reference.
See the reference at the bottom of the page.
